summary: Read your Miniflux feeds anywhere. Needs an account.
page_description: Bring unread Miniflux articles to your Kobo and keep reading without Wi-Fi. Digest is an unofficial client and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Miniflux project.
release_notes: On a Kobo Clara Colour or Libra Colour article pictures are shown in colour. Black-and-white readers look exactly as before.

steps.text: Set up the reader once over USB, if you have not already. Miniflux must be reachable over HTTPS.
In Miniflux, create an API key (Settings, API Keys).
Connect Digest from your computer. It asks for the server and the key, checks them, ties the key to your server, and fills in the address. Open Digest, or tap Check again.
With the key in a file instead, the same setup is one command.
steps.command: kobo secret set miniflux --app rss-miniflux --server https://miniflux.example --from key.txt
